capabilities: create temporary notes named with today's date
auto-delete notes older than a set number of retention days
configure the temp folder name and retention settings
extras: Cleanup can run on startup or manually via the command palette; setting retention days to 0 disables auto-removal.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create throwaway dated notes that get cleaned up automatically instead of accumulating in the vault.
summary: Creates dated temporary notes in a temp folder and auto-deletes notes older than a configurable retention period.
